verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Dover only as an MCP server that exposes Dover data to outside AI clients. Nothing shows Dover acting as an MCP client that can connect to external MCP servers and call their tools. An AI-enabled recruiting platform could plausibly offer that, so the axis applies, but the server-role evidence is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
